_comment: Least-privilege policy for the gateway instance. Replace REGION, ACCOUNT_ID, DATA_VOLUME_ID and ASG_NAME. Attach alongside the AWS-managed AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore policy. Note this box may run agents that execute arbitrary code, so they inherit this role via IMDS - keep it this narrow.

Statement._comment: Describe* does not support resource-level permissions, so Resource must be *.
Scoped to exactly one volume. The instance ARN wildcard is required because the instance id is not known until launch.
An explicit Deny cannot be overridden by any Allow. This is the backstop that stops a compromised or buggy agent destroying the data volume or resizing the group.
